<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="390" height="844" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="tinderGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FE3675"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FF7854"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="150%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="4" stdDeviation="7" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity="0.14"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#F5F7FA"/>

  <!-- Gradient header -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="252" fill="url(#tinderGradient)"/>
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="30" fill="#FE3675" opacity="0.16"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <text x="20" y="20" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13px" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF">9:41</text>
  <line x1="331" y1="20" x2="331" y2="13" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="335" y1="20" x2="335" y2="11" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="339" y1="20" x2="339" y2="9" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="343" y1="20" x2="343" y2="7" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="354" cy="15" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.6"/>
  <line x1="357" y1="18" x2="361" y2="22" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.6"/>
  <rect x="367" y="10" width="18" height="11" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="385" y="13" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Header navigation -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="35" cy="65" r="20" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.2"/>
    <polyline points="40,57 32,65 40,73" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <line x1="33" y1="65" x2="47" y2="65" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>
  <text x="195" y="70" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="21px" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF">tinder</text>
  <g>
    <circle cx="355" cy="65" r="20" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.2"/>
    <circle cx="355" cy="60" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <ellipse cx="355" cy="70" rx="7" ry="4" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Header balance summary -->
  <text x="195" y="119" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12px" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.88">CURRENT BALANCE</text>
  <text x="195" y="166" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="38px" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF">$24.50</text>
  <text x="195" y="190" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13px" font-weight="normal" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.9">Available Tinder balance</text>
  <g>
    <circle cx="146" cy="221" r="13" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.22"/>
    <line x1="146" y1="215" x2="146" y2="227" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <line x1="141" y1="221" x2="151" y2="221" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <text x="166" y="225" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12px" font-weight="normal" fill="#FFFFFF">Add funds securely</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Main sheet -->
  <rect x="13" y="239" width="364" height="528" rx="24" fill="#000000" opacity="0.1"/>
  <rect x="13" y="235" width="364" height="528" rx="24" fill="#FFFFFF" filter="url(#shadow)"/>

  <text x="32" y="274" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="20px" font-weight="bold" fill="#4A4A4A">Add balance</text>
  <text x="32" y="297" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12px" font-weight="normal" fill="#939393">Choose an amount to keep your account ready.</text>

  <!-- Amount choices -->
  <text x="32" y="329" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13px" font-weight="bold" fill="#4A4A4A">SELECT AMOUNT</text>

  <g>
    <rect x="29" y="343" width="98" height="58" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="78" y="378" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16px" font-weight="bold" fill="#4A4A4A">$10</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="146" y="343" width="98" height="58" rx="14" fill="#FE3675" opacity="0.12" stroke="#FE3675" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="195" y="378" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16px" font-weight="bold" fill="#C42936">$25</text>
    <circle cx="230" cy="357" r="8" fill="#FE3675"/>
    <polyline points="226,357 229,360 235,353" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="263" y="343" width="98" height="58" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="312" y="378" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16px" font-weight="bold" fill="#4A4A4A">$50</text>
  </g>

  <line x1="31" y1="421" x2="359" y2="421" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Payment method -->
  <text x="32" y="452" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13px" font-weight="bold" fill="#4A4A4A">PAYMENT METHOD</text>
  <g>
    <rect x="29" y="466" width="332" height="67" rx="14" fill="#F5F7FA"/>
    <rect x="45" y="483" width="43" height="30" rx="5" fill="#4A4A4A"/>
    <rect x="45" y="490" width="43" height="6" fill="#EFC54D"/>
    <text x="66" y="509" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10px" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF">VISA</text>
    <text x="105" y="491" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14px" font-weight="bold" fill="#4A4A4A">•••• 4821</text>
    <text x="105" y="512" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11px" font-weight="normal" fill="#939393">Personal card</text>
    <polyline points="337,493 343,499 337,505" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Promo and secure note -->
  <g>
    <rect x="29" y="548" width="332" height="54" rx="13" fill="#FFF4F6"/>
    <circle cx="54" cy="575" r="14" fill="#FE3675" opacity="0.16"/>
    <polygon points="54,566 56,572 62,572 57,576 59,582 54,578 49,582 51,576 46,572 52,572" fill="#FE3675"/>
    <text x="78" y="571" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12px" font-weight="bold" fill="#C42936">Balance bonus</text>
    <text x="78" y="588" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11px" font-weight="normal" fill="#939393">Get $2 extra when you add $25 or more.</text>
  </g>

  <g>
    <rect x="29" y="618" width="332" height="48" rx="24" fill="url(#tinderGradient)"/>
    <text x="195" y="648" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14px" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF">ADD $25.00</text>
  </g>
  <text x="195" y="692" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11px" font-weight="normal" fill="#939393">You'll be charged securely to Visa •••• 4821</text>
  <circle cx="174" cy="716" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#96E063" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <polyline points="171,716 173,718 177,713" fill="none" stroke="#96E063" stroke-width="1.4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <text x="187" y="720" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10px" font-weight="normal" fill="#939393">Secure payment</text>

  <!-- Navigation bar -->
  <rect x="0" y="768" width="390" height="76" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="768" x2="390" y2="768" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Explore -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="39" cy="793" r="10" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <polygon points="39,787 42,793 39,799 36,793" fill="#939393"/>
    <text x="39" y="824" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10px" font-weight="normal" fill="#939393">Explore</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Likes -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="117" cy="793" r="18" fill="#FE3675" opacity="0.12"/>
    <polygon points="117,800 108,792 108,788 111,785 117,789 123,785 126,788 126,792" fill="#FE3675"/>
    <text x="117" y="824" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10px" font-weight="normal" fill="#939393">Likes</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Matches -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="195" cy="793" r="10" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <circle cx="191" cy="791" r="3" fill="#939393"/>
    <circle cx="199" cy="791" r="3" fill="#939393"/>
    <line x1="189" y1="797" x2="201" y2="797" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="195" y="824" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10px" font-weight="normal" fill="#939393">Matches</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Balance active -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="273" cy="793" r="18" fill="url(#tinderGradient)"/>
    <rect x="266" y="787" width="14" height="12" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <line x1="269" y1="791" x2="277" y2="791" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    <line x1="269" y1="795" x2="275" y2="795" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    <text x="273" y="824" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10px" font-weight="bold" fill="#FE3675">Balance</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Profile -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="351" cy="793" r="10" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <circle cx="351" cy="789" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <ellipse cx="351" cy="797" rx="5" ry="3" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="351" y="824" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10px" font-weight="normal" fill="#939393">Profile</text>
  </g>
</svg>
